page.overview:
Who is Alus Restor?

Yoshitaka Amano (original promotional artworks)Akihiko Yoshida (3D remake character design)

Prince Alus Restor is the young crown prince of Saronia in Final Fantasy III. The party meets him after he has been exiled by the king, and he becomes a supporting character for a time, aiding the Light Warriors with white magic.

Alus is a young boy with white hair. He wears a long orange cloak. His Famicom sprite is red and white and he wears a crown, whereas his Yoshitaka Amano artwork depicts him wielding a longsword.

Alus is an outspoken prince, but is shy and has fallen on hard times. In the 3D remake version Arc takes a liking to him despite the age difference, as both of them were belittled in the past. When new responsibilities are laid upon him, he believes that he can no longer see Arc due to his duties.
